Its 24 Hasse incidence vertices give exactly f=(24,216,896,1692,1248,256), total 4332 nonempty acyclic matchings; independent enumerator rebuilt the 14-node directed Hasse graph, reversed disjoint chosen edges and checked all acyclic faces. The published B≈∨21 S³∨24 S⁴ implies rational homology ranks (21,24) and whole boundary ranks d5=256,d4=968,d3=703. Packaged tetra_boundary_char.py was read in full: it builds oriented differentials and signed invariant chain sums for the ten S4×C2 conjugacy classes and their powers, computes fixed-boundary ranks at primes 1009,10007; prime orders are coprime to 1,2,3,4,6 and whole ranks equal known rational ranks, so averaging direct-summand localizations ensure fixed ranks over Q. Cyclotomic inversion yields degree-3 natural (21,-3,1,0,-1) and ghost (9,1,-3,0,-1), degree-4 natural (24,-2,0,0,-2) and ghost (0,-2,0,0,2); independently computed complete signed Lefschetz differences and Specht ghost ± multiplicities (15,6), (12,12). Quotient rational invariants follow by transfer and character averaging. This run did not execute the full invariant-boundary rank checker; its exact finite algorithm and existing full output were materially inspected, and independent face/Lefschetz/character arithmetic verified, not misdescribed as a new full modular-rank reproduction.
